commands.name: init
commands.brief: make .sticky/ and tell your agents about it
args: --skill          a Claude Code skill instead of the instruction files
--no-agent-docs  the folder only
--view V         where the board shows: terminal, app (the desktop app) or both
--style S        the app's look: doodle or neat
--language L     the board's language, and the welcome note's: ko, en or auto

commands.name: setup
commands.brief: install the board plugin for Claude Code and Codex
args: --scope S       user, project or local (Claude Code; Codex has user only)
--mcp           also register stickypane as an MCP server
--plugin=false  leave the plugin as it is: with --mcp, the MCP server only (default true)
--agents L      claude, codex or both (default: those found)
--command P     the stickypane the MCP server runs, a full path
--undo          uninstall the plugin (and the MCP server with --mcp)
--dry-run       print the plan and run nothing
--yes           run without asking
--status        say where each agent stands, and run nothing
--json          with --status, print it as JSON

commands.name: config
commands.brief: list, read or change a setting

commands.name: keys
commands.brief: list the board's keys or change them
args: --json  print the keys as JSON

commands.name: kinds
commands.brief: list the shapes a note can take

commands.name: env
commands.brief: say what the board found about where it runs
args: --json  print what was found as JSON

commands.name: guide
commands.brief: print the agent guide

commands.name: version
commands.brief: print the version

commands.name: help
commands.brief: this help: a command, a shape, or getting started
args: --all   every command with every option, in one page
--json  every command's name, syntax and examples as JSON, in English

commands.name: note list
commands.brief: list the notes
args: --json  print the list as JSON

commands.name: worktree list
commands.brief: list the git worktrees the board follows
args: --json  print the list as JSON

commands.name: worktree show
commands.brief: show one worktree the board follows
args: --json  print it as JSON

commands.name: index
commands.brief: every note in a line: title, counts, a gist
args: --json  print the index as JSON

commands.name: note show
commands.brief: put a note, a file or a folder on the screen

commands.name: note hide
commands.brief: fold a note away

commands.name: note cat
commands.brief: print a note's file

commands.name: note write
commands.brief: create or replace a note from standard input
commands.syntax: stickypane note write <name> [--type T] [--title X] [--open] [--size S] [--opt k=v]
args: --type T   the shape: note, board, checklist, log, chart, form, script
--title X  the note's title
--open     put the note on the screen now
--size S   the width: 1/4, 1/3, 1/2, 2/3, 3/4 or 1 of the screen (or card, half, page)
--opt k=v  a create option of the shape (stickypane kinds lists them), repeated for more lines; the shape writes the note and standard input is not read
examples: echo "- [ ] build" | stickypane note write plan --type checklist --title "Release" --open
stickypane note write sprint --type board --opt columns=Backlog --opt columns=Done
echo "- [ ] a" | stickypane note write deploy/steps --type checklist

commands.name: page add
commands.brief: add a page to a book

commands.name: page list
commands.brief: list the pages of a book
args: --json  print the pages as JSON

commands.name: todo
commands.brief: add, tick or untick a checklist item

commands.name: card
commands.brief: add or move a card of a board
args: --to C  the column to add to, or to move to (needed to move)
examples: stickypane card add work "login API" --to Doing
stickypane card move work login --to Done

commands.name: chart
commands.brief: set or add to a number of a chart

commands.name: log
commands.brief: append a line to a log note
args: --time  start the line with the time

commands.name: chat
commands.brief: add a message to a chat note
args: --as W  who says it (default: agent)
examples: stickypane chat add chat "deploy is green" --as ci

commands.name: note set
commands.brief: change keys of a note or its place on the board
examples: stickypane note set plan open=true size=1/2
stickypane note set plan title="The plan"

commands.name: note mv
commands.brief: rename a note or move it into a tab or book

commands.name: note link
commands.brief: show a file or folder of the project without copying

commands.name: note rm
commands.brief: move a note, a page or a folder to .trash/

commands.name: note restore
commands.brief: bring back what note rm removed last

commands.name: note archive
commands.brief: move a note out of sight into archive/

commands.name: answers
commands.brief: print what the user answered in a form
args: --json  print the answers as JSON

commands.name: wait
commands.brief: wait for a form's button, then print the answers
args: --timeout D  give up after this long, such as 5m (default: wait for good)
--json       print the answers as JSON

commands.name: api
commands.brief: (experimental) send the requests of a .http note
args: --env E  the environment to use
--all     send every request, in order

commands.name: watch
commands.brief: print what happens on the board as it happens
args: --note N     only these notes or folders, comma-separated
--type T     only these events or their kinds (card, item.ticked)
--json       print each event as JSON
--exec CMD   run CMD for each event
--once       end after the first event
--timeout D  give up after this long, such as 10m

commands.name: mcp
commands.brief: serve the notes over MCP

commands.name: bridge
commands.brief: serve the board to the desktop app
